detail.summary_line: Solar-powered IoT monitoring and automatic pump control for precision irrigation.

system.title: Monitor over MQTT
system.text: ESP8266 substations · Raspberry Pi 4 · Django web dashboard

system.title: Control the pump
system.text: On below 45 % soil moisture · off at 80 %

detail.system_note: Simplified system overview · Based on the published study
detail.overview: Field substations measure soil moisture and climate and report to a solar-powered base station, which switches the irrigation pump automatically and lets farmers monitor and control it remotely.

results.title: Remote monitoring and control
results.text: Real-time readings and pump control through a web dashboard.

results.title: Solar autonomy
results.text: A 20 W panel and a 12 V, 7.5 Ah battery run the pump for at least two hours at night.
